description: Solves anagram by sorting character arrays in O(n log n) instead of O(n) counting array.

transcript.text: To check if two strings are anagrams, if we sort both strings and they are equal, then they are anagrams.
Can you do it without sorting in O(n) time?
Sorting is very easy in Java with Arrays.sort. I'll convert both to char arrays, sort them, and compare.
What is the time complexity of your approach?
Sorting is O(n log n). So it is O(n log n) time and O(n) space for the char arrays.
